description: Build ready-to-paste CSS animations: pick an effect, duration, easing and loop count, preview it live, then copy the @keyframes and class code.

faqs.a: The code is plain CSS3 with no dependencies. It works in all modern browsers; older browsers may need vendor prefixes, which the generator omits by default.
faqs.q: Does the generated code need any library?

faqs.a: Yes — the class name uses a generic name like .animate-fade-in and the keyframes have matching names. You can rename them freely in the copied code.
faqs.q: Can I rename the animation class?

faqs.a: The duration slider covers 0.2s to 5s and iteration can be a fixed count or infinite. For longer loops, edit the duration value in the copied CSS.
faqs.q: What range do duration and iterations cover?

howto: Choose an animation type (fade, slide, bounce, spin, pulse, shake).
Set the duration, timing function, iteration count and delay.
Watch the live preview update instantly.
Click "Copy CSS" and paste the @keyframes + class into your stylesheet.
title: CSS Animation Generator
